studies.label: Model Connectivity Network — How the Curated Models Couple

nodes.label:

is...
nodes.statement:
The curated corpus is a connected shared-variable system, not a scatter of
isolated models: 1,456 models link through shared molecular species into a
dominant 634-model component (43.5%) centered on core-metabolism hub
variables (ATP, translation, apoptosis), with a parallel 1,704-edge anatomy
layer. This is an emergent property of independent curation practice — the
same species and tissues recur across models authored in isolation — and it
gives a concrete integration map of where existing models already overlap.
